query_text: Suresh Perera died on 10 December 1995 intestate. Suresh Perera had an offspring named Samantha from his first marriage, who is a citizen of the United States of America. Can Samantha become entitled to the intestate estate of Suresh Perera? Discuss with reference to the provisions of the Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act No. 38 of 2014, as amended.
